summary_md: **Hariom Dubey ([@Hariomdubey177](https://x.com/Hariomdubey177/status/2115677910468342058))** built **Warden-AI**, a zero-trust local gateway for AI coding agents. Per his self-thread, it intercepts MCP calls, lets safe reads pass, and holds destructive actions while streaming the diff and command to a local dashboard for approve/reject, with SQLite audit logs, all running locally in Docker.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - hariom123-dev/Warden-AI: An open-source Zero-Trust gateway for AI coding agents. Intercepts MCP tool calls, freezes execution in memory, and forces manual approval via a React dashboard before allowing the AI to touch your local filesystem.

relevance: Human-in-the-loop policy enforcement for local coding agents.
